## 1. Uses

Read [the spec](../../vol/SPEC/entry-point.md) first, then [the spec](../../vol/SPEC/2-the-walk.md), "The walk" for detail.
A wrapped quote: [the spec](../../vol/SPEC/2-the-walk.md),
"The walk" opens this line.
Unmapped heading: [the spec](../../vol/SPEC/entry-point.md), "No such heading" goes to the entry point.
With a fragment [spec](../../vol/SPEC/entry-point.md) drops it; [notes](../../notes.md#keep) keeps it.
